claims.assertion: Yazhi says Alfrateans and Antarians enforce a Federation blockade around Earth; ships must file flight plans, though some can pass.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She describes the human and extraterrestrial boundary as unclear.

claims.assertion: Swaruu X says Lurkers are silicon-based, unlike carbon-based Lyrians such as Taygetans; this is a difference, not an upgrade.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X

claims.assertion: Swaruu X says solar portals open around the northern summer solstice; a large Arcturian biosphere ship recently used one, producing a magnetic anomaly.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X
claims.qualifiers: She calls this routine and predictable.
